name: GreenEcho Floating Chat Button
author: Prakash Sahu

sections.description:
GreenEcho is the ultimate WhatsApp Chat plugin designed to help you boost sales and provide instant support. This Click to Chat tool adds a beautiful, lightweight Floating Button to your website, allowing visitors to start a conversation with just one click.

Whether you are a small business owner or a developer, our WhatsApp Chat button is the easiest way to connect with your audience. Unlike other heavy plugins, GreenEcho is built for speed and performance.

Key Features of GreenEcho WhatsApp Chat:

  • One-Click Setup: Get your Floating Button live in less than a minute.
  • Custom Welcome Message: Set a pre-filled message for your users (New in v1.0.3).
  • Lightweight & Fast: Minimal code that won’t slow down your WordPress site.
  • Mobile Optimized: Perfect Click to Chat experience for mobile users.
  • Clean UI: Professional design that fits any website theme.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the greenecho-floating-chat-button folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > GreenEcho Chat to configure your WhatsApp number and Welcome Message.
  4. Your Floating Button is now live!
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes! The core WhatsApp Chat features are completely free. We also have a Pro version for advanced business needs.

Does it support international numbers?

Yes, just make sure to enter your number with the country code (e.g., 91 for India) without any plus sign or spaces.
